topology.f2_path: SWF2 is the normally closed modeled VD-to-VB bank path; opening it can isolate the 2240 uF bank.
topology.failed_branch: Sswfail connects sw to channel_source independently of Msw gate control, so a failed-MOS path is gate-independent and bypasses F2.
topology.local_storage: The 19.8 uF Clocal is on VD and remains outside the F2-isolated bank path.
topology.source_path: Bridge/source -> Lboost -> sw feeds the failed branch; F2 opening does not interrupt this mains-fed route.

partial_model_evidence.interpretation: q/en high and a low gate sample is ordinary PWM behavior, not external-latch shutdown; iL is a fixed-model sample only, not physical 182 A.
partial_model_evidence.abort: Numerical abort before endpoint; root cause remains unresolved.

future_functional_requirements: Independent failed-channel detection and latched default-off control; do not infer shutdown from PWM-low gate samples.
Interrupt the source-fed gate-independent failed branch.
Isolate and safely discharge the VD/VB stored-energy path with DC interruption/no-restrike evidence.
Measure VD, VB, both F2 terminals/current, source and failed-branch current, and q/en/gate transitions.

scope_boundaries.future_test: A complete endpoint-resolved fault run is unrun; no retry or causal mechanism is established here.
scope_boundaries.hardware: Part selection, DC clearing, arc/restrike, thermal/SOA, and production protection remain hardware/manufacturer work.
scope_boundaries.inductor: The 180 uH model is linear and lacks DC-bias/saturation/thermal laws; 43 A is typical saturation, not a guarantee.

method: Read-only review of the frozen deck, parent disposition, exact 256-row tail receipt, authoritative inductor review, and current prototype decision aid; no solver, raw scan, code, schematic, or part selection.
